about.title: Tiburon Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Tiburon is a small, tight-knit community of about 9,214 people, and most days here feel unhurried — but a defective product doesn't care where you live. Whether it's a faulty appliance in a home overlooking the bay, a malfunctioning bike component along Paradise Drive, or a tool that failed on a boat near the marina, defective products cause real harm here just as they do anywhere else. California law gives injured consumers a real advantage: strict product liability generally means you don't have to prove the manufacturer was careless, only that the product was defective and that the defect caused your injury. That applies whether the failure was in the design, the manufacturing process, or a missing warning label. LawProactive isn't a law firm — we're a free service that connects you with an independent attorney in Marin County who can evaluate what happened, help you preserve the product as evidence, and explain your options. There's no fee unless your case results in a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Strict Liability Matters for Your Case

items.title: You Don't Have to Prove Negligence
items.desc: Under California's strict liability rules, showing the product was defective and caused your injury is often enough — you don't need to prove the manufacturer was careless.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially be held liable, which can matter if the company that made the product is hard to identify or reach.

items.title: Design, Manufacturing, and Warning Defects All Count
items.desc: Whether the flaw was in how the product was designed, how it was built, or a failure to warn of a known risk, each type of defect can support a claim.

items.question: What should I do with the product that hurt me?
items.answer: Keep it exactly as it was at the time of the injury, if you safely can, along with any packaging, manuals, or receipts. This evidence often matters a great deal in a product liability claim. Don't attempt repairs or alterations, since that can complicate the case.

items.question: Do I need to prove the manufacturer was negligent?
items.answer: Generally, no. California's strict liability standard usually only requires showing the product was defective and that the defect caused your injury, not that anyone acted carelessly. An independent attorney can walk you through how this applies to your specific situation.

items.question: Is this only for injuries that happen in stores or online purchases?
items.answer: No. In a community like Tiburon, defective products cause injuries in homes, on boats, along roads like Tiburon Boulevard or Paradise Drive, and anywhere else people use everyday items. Where the injury occurred matters less than proving the product itself was defective.
